## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Affected scope

List affected pages, drivers, configuration, tools, or documentation. Explain changes to hardware assumptions or frozen decisions, if any.

## Verification

List checks actually performed and results, or state what was not checked. For device checks, include board revision, firmware/ESP-IDF version, configuration and power state. Compilation alone does not verify hardware behavior. Documentation-only changes do not require a build.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows existing component boundaries and applicable frozen decisions.
- [ ] Documentation and translations are updated where relevant, or remaining work is noted.
- [ ] New files have appropriate license/source information and preserve third-party notices.
- [ ] No credentials, private identifiers, personal content, or confidential material are included.
